_note: 1863 roads of the Vicksburg campaign, control points [lat, lon]. Smoothed with Catmull-Rom + a small wobble by make_roads.py. 'snap' = indices of points snapped to the nearest river pixel of the basemap (ferries / bridge). 'approx' = how sure the line is (see README.md). 'end_fade' = which ends taper out inside the map (0 = start, 1 = end); ends at the map frame fade automatically.
